topic: Defocused Reflector Design Impact on Performance Metrics
consensus_response: The defocused reflector design generally has a higher SNR due to better pattern control and reduced interference. In contrast, the conventional reflector design typically shows a significant reduction in SNR when elements fail. The defocused reflector can maintain better beam pointing accuracy, reducing the impact of element failures on the system's performance. The defocused reflector can maintain higher system throughput, even when some elements fail.
